content: Lydia: Damn mages and their floating lights.
Savos Aren: I see you're not a student here, yet you carry yourself like a warrior. Tell me, does your thane share the College’s interest in the arcane arts?
Sergius Turrianus: Fuck me sideways, Savos—another batch of Nords just sent their wives' tits-for-brains requests for 'enchanted nipple clamps.

(The location is now Winterhold College.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Mirabelle Ervine, Sergius Turrianus, Enthir, Daegon, Lydia) (MJR: ...; Savos Aren: You are relatively new here, are you not? I have noticed you, but we have not spoken. MJR: No, we haven't.; Savos Aren: Then allow me to introduce myself. MJR: I need to speak to you about Saarthal.; Savos Aren: Please don't tell me that another one of the apprentices has been incinerated. I have enough to deal with right now. MJR: We found some sort of... orb. Tolfdir wanted you to see it.; Savos Aren: I... see. I trust that Tolfdir will provide a more... specific explanation. MJR: ...; Savos Aren: Thank you for bringing this to my attention. Tolfdir normally looks after your little group, yes? Since he's apparently occupied, and I will need to see this discovery for myself, I think perhaps you should begin researching the subject. Speak with Urag in the Arcanaeum. See if he's aware of anything that matches your discovery. And... good work. The next time you find yourself exploring Nordic ruins, perhaps this will be helpful.)

Savos Aren: The night air is crisp tonight. Perfect for magical experimentation, don't you think? The stars are aligning in a way that amplifies alteration magic. Serana: You know what else amplifies things? A good dose of Skooma and a willing partner. But I suppose Arch-Mages prefer their thrills from dusty tomes rather than dusty loins. Savos Aren: My dear, you underestimate the hobbies of academia. Some of the most potent spells I've cast were while. .. multitasking. Serana: I bet you practice your incinerate spell on candles while reading erotic poetry about Dibella. Savos Aren: Dibella's domains are far more nuanced than simple poetry.
